title: Unused spawn_codex_runtime in non-test builds after delegation-owned app-servers
outcome: Unused spawn_codex_runtime in non-test builds after delegation-owned app-servers
acceptance: A non-test build (`cargo check --bin termal`) reports no `spawn_codex_runtime` is never used warning, and otherwise exactly the warnings master reports.
The test build compiles, and the existing tests that call spawn_codex_runtime pass unchanged.
